order.p_text.all_major_credit_cards_via_: All major credit cards (via Stripe), PayPal, and bank transfer for projects over $1,000. We do not accept cryptocurrency at this time.
order.p_text.get_a_detailed_quote_with_e: Get a detailed quote with exact pricing — no hidden fees, no pressure to commit.
order.p_text.if_your_project_requires_mo: If your project requires more than the standard scope (e.g. 4 hours of footage instead of 1), we'll quote a custom price before starting — you always know what you're paying for. We do not charge for file delivery, format conversions, or basic revisions.
order.p_text.just_reply_to_the_quote_ema: Just reply to the quote email with the additional info. We'll update the quote and timeline if needed. You can also send files and additional context after submitting — Sofia will track everything in your project folder.
order.p_text.no_the_quote_is_yours_to_re: No. The quote is yours to review, ask questions about, accept, or decline. There's no commitment until you confirm. If you accept and we start work, the price is locked in — no surprise charges.
order.p_text.our_pricing_is_per_project_: Our pricing is per-project, not per-hour — so you know the cost upfront with no surprise overages. We accept credit cards (Stripe), PayPal, and bank transfer for larger projects. Invoices are sent on delivery; payment is due within 14 days.
order.p_text.step1_review_desc.805a6e50: Sofia (Client Experience) reads your form within 24 hours — usually within 4 hours during business days. She reviews your service selection, timeline, and any links you provided.
order.p_text.step2_sample_footage_desc.7: For restoration, AI generation, or trailer services, we ask for a 30-60 second sample clip to verify the source quality and confirm the service will deliver the expected result. This is free and takes 1-2 business days.
order.p_text.step3_quote_desc.22afeabd: You receive a detailed quote with: the recommended service(s), exact pricing, timeline, deliverables list, and any options or upsells. No hidden fees. The quote is yours to accept or decline — no pressure.
order.p_text.step4_confirm_start_desc.22: Once you accept (usually by replying "go ahead"), we send a short intake form for upload links, branding preferences, and any special requirements. Production starts within 1-2 business days of intake.
order.p_text.step5_drafts_final_desc.a8e: For most services, you get a draft within 3-7 days. You can request changes (2 rounds included). Final files are delivered in your preferred format — typically MP4 for video, MP3 for audio, plus any social-media-specific cuts.
order.p_text.tell_us_about_your_project_: Tell us about your project and we'll get back to you within 24 hours with a personalized quote — no commitment required.
order.p_text.two_free_revisions_included: Two free revisions included. Full refund if we can't meet your requirements.
order.p_text.upload_via_google_drive_wet: Upload via Google Drive, WeTransfer, or our secure portal. Files deleted 30 days after delivery.
order.p_text.we_ll_respond_within_24_hou: Sofia reads every form within 24 hours — usually within 4 hours during business days. No commitment, free consultation.
order.p_text.we_respond_to_all_inquiries: We respond to all inquiries within 24 hours, often much faster.
order.p_text.within_24_hours_of_submitti: Within 24 hours of submitting this form — usually much faster during US business hours. If your project is time-sensitive, mention it in the details field and we'll prioritize.
order.p_text.yes_if_you_cancel_before_we: Yes. If you cancel before we start any work, full refund. If we have started work, we refund the unworked portion (pro-rated by hours invested). After delivery, our standard satisfaction guarantee applies — full refund if you're not happy after 2 revision rounds.
